about: Pass 9 (2026-10-10): models that the licensed LLM sources in the ledger already measure but data/models.json lacks (all sources except LMArena). Every pinned source file was re-read and its labels matched against the notes of existing rows; unmatched labels were resolved to an exact Hugging Face repo (pinned sha via the HF API) or a dated/fixed API model id, and all rows each model has across these sources were built with the existing note conventions of each source. Open-weight entries carry a transformers command for the exact repo (gb from the repo's weight files, marked gb_estimated) and a context window only where the maker's pinned config.json falls under an existing first-party facts entry. Retired API snapshots are comparison-only. Rows for catalogued models are included only where the label was never mapped (Epoch files for recently added models, label quirks, Granite Code 34B/3B in BigCodeBench).
